item.coloph: ces lha mo srid gsum dbang bsgyur rgyal mo'i gsol 'debs yid kyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rgyal khyung dge bshes rtsa yi gdung las son pas (pa'i) skyes mchog ye shes gsal ldan gyis/ 'di lta bur zhig dgos kyi nan tan bka' yis bskul ngor/ mi chung ming chen 'dzin pa'i kun grol grags pa bdag gis nyag shod a 'dzi lung gi byang gnas/ sa gnas thim shing rgyal bas (ba'i) sa gnad/ g.yung drung dpal gyi gdan sa bkra shis smin grol khrod du bgyis pa/ me sbrul zla ba drug pa'i phyogs phyi ma dam can 'du ba'i nyin la dge'o//
